coauthors.name: Jea Kwon
coauthors.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP)
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-first author of 'Exploring Persona-dependent LLM Alignment for the Moral Machine Experiment' (arXiv:2504.10886), which measures how LLM moral judgments shift with assigned personas; also authors 'Dropouts in Confidence: Moral Uncertainty in Human-LLM Alignment' and 'Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas: Moral Rightness, Predicted Human Behavior, and Model Decisions' (arXiv:2604.21871). Core topic is value alignment of LLMs on moral dilemmas.

coauthors.name: Luiz Felipe Vecchietti
coauthors.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) / KAIST
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Author on the whole moral-values-in-LLM line: 'Exploring Persona-dependent LLM Alignment for the Moral Machine Experiment' (arXiv:2504.10886), 'Dropouts in Confidence: Moral Uncertainty in Human-LLM Alignment', and 'Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas' (arXiv:2604.21871) - persona- and culture-conditioned moral preference alignment of LLMs.

coauthors.name: Meeyoung Cha
coauthors.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) / KAIST School of Computing
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Senior author on 'Exploring Persona-dependent LLM Alignment for the Moral Machine Experiment' (arXiv:2504.10886) and 'Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas' (arXiv:2604.21871); also 'Dropouts in Confidence: Moral Uncertainty in Human-LLM Alignment', 'Human Perceptions on Moral Responsibility of AI' and 'Quantitative Analysis of Cultural Dynamics Seen from an Event-based Social Network'. Directly on moral/cultural value alignment of machine decisions.

coauthors.name: Alice Oh
coauthors.affiliation: KAIST School of Computing (Users & Information Lab)
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Advisor and senior author on 'KoBBQ: Korean Bias Benchmark for Question Answering' (arXiv:2307.16778), a culturally-adapted Korean bias benchmark built by re-localizing US-centric BBQ categories to Korean social context; also on 'BLEnD: A Benchmark for LLMs on Everyday Knowledge in Diverse Cultures and Languages' and 'CLIcK: A Benchmark Dataset of Cultural and Linguistic Intelligence in Korean'. Explicit cultural-localization-of-values work in LLM/NLP.

coauthors.name: Hwaran Lee
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-author of KoBBQ (arXiv:2307.16778) and author of 'KorNAT: LLM Alignment Benchmark for Korean Social Values and Common Knowledge' - a benchmark measuring LLM alignment to a nation's social values; also 'BLEnD: A Benchmark for LLMs on Everyday Knowledge in Diverse Cultures and Languages', 'BLEnD-Vis: Benchmarking Multimodal Cultural Understanding in Vision Language Models' and 'KoSBi: A Dataset for Mitigating Social Bias Risks'. Squarely national/cultural value alignment of LLMs.

coauthors.name: Jiho Jin
coauthors.relevance_evidence: First author of KoBBQ (arXiv:2307.16778); also authors 'Survey of Cultural Awareness in Language Models: Text and Beyond', 'CulTrace: Tracing Internal Cultural Reasoning in Large Language Models', 'JuICE: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Judge in Identifying Cultural Errors' and 'Pluralis v0.1: Towards a Multicultural, Multimodal, Multilingual Benchmark for AI Risk and Reliability'. Dedicated cultural-awareness-in-LLM researcher.

coauthors.name: Nayeon Lee
coauthors.relevance_evidence: KoBBQ co-author (arXiv:2307.16778); also 'Exploring Cross-Cultural Differences in English Hate Speech Annotations: From Dataset Construction to Analysis' and 'BLEnD: A Benchmark for LLMs on Everyday Knowledge in Diverse Cultures and Languages' - explicit cross-cultural difference and cultural-knowledge evaluation for LLMs, not generic fairness.

coauthors.name: Haneul Yoo
coauthors.relevance_evidence: KoBBQ co-author (arXiv:2307.16778); also 'CLIcK: A Benchmark Dataset of Cultural and Linguistic Intelligence in Korean' and 'From National Curricula to Cultural Awareness: Constructing Open-Ended Culture-Specific Question Answering Dataset' - construction of culture-specific evaluation resources for language models.

coauthors.name: Wenchao Dong
coauthors.affiliation: KAIST / Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-author of 'Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas' (arXiv:2604.21871); also first-author work 'Persona Setting Pitfall: Persistent Outgroup Biases in Large Language Models Arising from Social Identity Adoption' and 'I Am Not Them: Fluid Identities and Persistent Out-group Bias in Large Language Models' - how group/cultural identity personas shift LLM value judgments.

coauthors.name: Jaehong Kim
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-author of 'Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas' (arXiv:2604.21871); also 'Moral Outrage Shapes Commitments Beyond Attention: Multimodal Moral Emotions on YouTube in Korea and the US' (explicit cross-cultural Korea/US moral comparison) and 'Quantitative Analysis of Cultural Dynamics Seen from an Event-based Social Network'.

coauthors.name: Chani Jung
coauthors.relevance_evidence: First author of 'Perceptions to Beliefs' (arXiv:2407.06004) and author of 'Exploring Cross-Cultural Differences in English Hate Speech Annotations: From Dataset Construction to Analysis', which studies how annotators' cultural background changes value-laden hate-speech judgments used to train/evaluate NLP models.

coauthors.name: Yejin Choi
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-author on 'Perceptions to Beliefs' (arXiv:2407.06004); relevant through 'DailyDilemmas: Revealing Value Preferences of LLMs with Quandaries of Daily Life' (eliciting LLM value preferences across moral frameworks) and 'CulturalTeaming: AI-Assisted Interactive Red-Teaming for Challenging LLMs' (Lack of) Multicultural Knowledge'.

coauthors.name: Hyunwoo Kim
